title: Pagination Component
objectives: Create a reusable pagination component with clean state management
Implement navigation controls with boundary handling
Support configurable page sizes and display options
Provide accessible and intuitive user interface
requirements: Create createPaginator function that returns pagination state and controls
Support navigation: first, previous, next, last, and direct page selection
Handle edge cases: first/last page boundaries, invalid page numbers
Implement renderControls function for basic UI representation
Support customizable items per page and total items count
Provide state snapshot for testing and debugging
stretchGoals: Add keyboard navigation support (arrow keys, Enter)
Implement URL synchronization for browser back/forward
Add accessibility features (ARIA labels, screen reader support)
constraints: Pure JavaScript implementation (no external UI libraries)
State should be immutable and predictable
Component should work in both browser and Node.js environments
